scripts.typecheck: pnpm run check:structure && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 run typecheck
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run check:structure && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 run test:coverage
scripts.build: pnpm run check:structure && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 run build
scripts.dod-check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:tooling && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:unused && pnpm audit --audit-level=high
